speaker: Forsythe
text: He seems confused by your question. "Did I not already reveal that? I am the mayor."

speaker: Forsythe
text: "Why yes, the Liche has been a horrible scourge on my poor town. First he drives away all visitors by raising the dead. Then, in an attempt to stop him, the town is destroyed in a terrible fire. Well, I suppose that is not strictly his fault, but, well, something had to be done about him." Forsythe looks a little flustered.

speaker: Forsythe
text: "Well, the alchemist is the one who started the fire!"

speaker: Forsythe
text: "That is what we call Caine. He is the alchemist who created the fire."

speaker: Forsythe
text: He puts his arm around your shoulders and whispers, "Mistress Mordra, our healer, thought she found a way to get rid of Horance once and for all. All we have to do is make a gold cage, or was it an old cage. Well, no matter."

speaker: Forsythe
text: "We make this cage, and someone..." He smiles at you, "...lowers it into the Well of Souls to do something or other to it. When this is done, thou shalt catch the Liche off guard late at night and snap it tight around him. Sounds easy thus far, yes?"

speaker: Forsythe
text: "Well, now. After that, thou needest only pour on him the magic liquid that the alchemist was making." He pauses here as if a little embarrassed.

speaker: Forsythe
text: "I apparently got the proportions a bit off when I told the alchemist about the formula. Anyway, it should be as easy as falling off a log, for thee. I guess thou hadst better be running along now, Mistress Mordra can tell thee ever so much more about this than can I. Be careful though, she is a dangerous old wench."

speaker: Forsythe
text: "Of course, now thou hast already taken care of all that!" He smile gracioulsy.

speaker: Forsythe
text: "'Twas so long ago that I barely remember. A smattering of curing, a dash of a potion of invisibility, and... that's right, a -ton- of the essence of mandrake root!"

speaker: Forsythe
text: "Well, if I've got all this Liche lore straight, then, Horance, who used to be a good and kindly mage, has become a nasty, horrible, undead mage." He smiles patronizingly. "Now run along. Thou canst ask Mordra if thou needest more information."

speaker: Forsythe
text: "She resides just across the way, and can help thee with everything thou mightest need to rid us of the Liche. Thank thee ever so much. It has been nice talking with thee. Goodbye." He scurries back into his corner and holds his ankh in a protective fashion.

speaker: Forsythe
text: "Oh, goodness no. I do not think I'm the one thou wantest for that job. No, I should think not. Maybe thou shouldst ask all of the townsfolk first. If none of them will do it, I might just think about it. Yes, that's right, thou shouldst just ask the others, then come back here to tell me who the poor soul is." He smiles at his own cleverness.

speaker: Forsythe
text: The Mayor's eyes dart back and forth as you ask him to sacrifice himself for the good of his people. "There is still one thou hast neglected to ask. Go and find <VAR>. Then come back and we'll see." Spectral sweat drips from his ghostly forehead.

speaker: Forsythe
text: "Just look for the crater near the northeast coast. Thou shalt find him there."

speaker: Forsythe
text: "The town healer said something about Rowena sitting on a throne in the Dark Tower on the northwestern point."

speaker: Forsythe
text: "As thou wishest!"

speaker: Forsythe
text: "Trent is in the smithy, not far from here, across the road."

speaker: Forsythe
text: "She can be found in her house, right across the road."

speaker: Forsythe
text: "Quen spends just about all of his time in the Keg Of Spirits tavern, near the ferry dock."

speaker: Forsythe
text: "Ah, that lovely girl is the barmaid of the Keg Of Spirits tavern, down by the ferry dock."

speaker: Forsythe
text: "That cantankerous man runs the tavern, the Keg Of Spirits. Thou canst find it near the ferry dock."

speaker: Forsythe
text: "Well, now. Just how didst thou come to this island? That is right. -That- ferryman. He is on the ferry of Skara Brae, to the southeast."

speaker: Forsythe
text: "Oh, yes, right. If I have forgotten to tell thee something, thou mayest come back and ask, all right." He sighs heavily as you start to leave, then returns to his vigil in the corner.

speaker: Shandu
text: You see a three-headed hydra. The head on the left speaks.

speaker: Shandu
text: "Wake up, there is something here."

speaker: Shanda
text: The head on the right looks up and at you.

speaker: Shanda
text: "I wonder if it is good to eat."

speaker: Shando
text: The middle head wakes with a start, sees you, becomes alarmed, and begins to snort excitedly.

speaker: Shandu
text: "Fear not, brother; we know it's there."

speaker: Shanda
text: "I wonder if it talks?"

speaker: Shandu
text: "We are not talking to thee! We are trying to eat thee!"

speaker: Shandu
text: "My name is Shandu. My brother next to me is Shanda. My brother next to him is Shando."

speaker: Shanda
text: "It does not matter what our names are!"

speaker: Shando
text: Shanda shakes his head and glares at you.

speaker: Shandu
text: "That is me."

speaker: Shandu
text: Shandu smiles and licks his lips.

speaker: Shandu
text: "I like it when my food says my name!"

speaker: Shando
text: Shanda rolls his eyes and exhales a puff of smoke from his nostrils.

speaker: Shanda
text: "Shanda says that thou shouldst refrain from saying his name. He does not like it when his food says his name."

speaker: Shanda
text: "That is me. I am the oldest brother."

speaker: Shandu
text: "We are all connected, Shando! Thou cannot be older!"

speaker: Shanda
text: "Mine head was the first to breathe the air."

speaker: Shandu
text: Shandu spits.

speaker: Shandu
text: "What does it matter? Our food does not care which of us is the eldest!"

speaker: Shandu
text: "Job?"

speaker: Shando
text: Shanda opens his mouth wide and emits a burst of flame.

speaker: Shanda
text: "He thinks that is a joke. Job! Ha! I think it is amusing, too. I have never heard my food tell jokes."

speaker: Shandu
text: "Ah, but brothers, we -do- have a job."

speaker: Shanda
text: "We do?"

speaker: Shandu
text: "We guard the Caddellite, do we not? Our purpose in life is to guard the Caddellite!"

speaker: Shando
text: Shanda becomes excited and snorts as if he were saying several sentences.

speaker: Shandu
text: "Thou dost want to know about Caddellite? Very well, I shall tell thee about Caddellite."

speaker: Shandu
text: The hydra shifts its weight a moment, then grins wickedly.

speaker: Shandu
text: "We are guarding it."

speaker: Shandu
text: "He wasn't talking to thee!"

speaker: Shanda
text: "The creature seems to echo everything we say, Shandu."

speaker: Shando
text: Shanda makes a horrid growling noise.

speaker: Shandu
text: "Shanda says he is hungry!"

speaker: Shanda
text: "So am I!"

speaker: Shandu
text: "Now that thou dost mention it, I am feeling a few hunger pangs myself. If we did not have to protect the Caddellite, I would eat this creature in a single gulp!"

speaker: Shandu
text: "Hearing this creature repeat whatever we say is making me hungry!"

speaker: Shanda
text: "It amuses me! Obviously it is a creature of severely limited intelligence!"

speaker: Shando
text: Shanda lets out a low growl.

speaker: Shandu
text: "Shanda says he wants something to eat!"

speaker: Shandu
text: "I suppose we must protect the Caddellite from creatures like thee who come around once every 1000 years or so wanting to take it."

speaker: Shando
text: Shanda growls louder than before, then breathes a bit of fire.

speaker: Shanda
text: "Creature! Thou art making Shanda angry! He thinks that thou art attempting to steal the Caddellite! Beware!"

speaker: Shandu
text: Shandu becomes enraged.

speaker: Shandu
text: "I knew it! It is trying to steal our Caddellite!"

speaker: Shandu
text: Shandu addresses his brothers.

speaker: Shandu
text: "We must not delay any longer."

speaker: Shando
text: Shanda roars angrily!

speaker: Shandu
text: "That is a good idea, my brother!"

speaker: Shandu
text: Shandu turns to you.

speaker: Shandu
text: ["This creature vaguely resembles a troll, only it smells a little more pleasant. Dost thou think it might taste better than a troll, Shando?"

speaker: Shanda
text: "We shall not know until we try!"

speaker: Shando
text: Shanda nods his head furiously, licking his lips.

speaker: Shandu
text: "Very well! Let's eat it!"

speaker: Shandu
text: "Thou cannot say 'bye' to us! How rude!"

speaker: Shandu
text: "Leaving so soon?"

speaker: Penumbra
text: The mage, having been asleep for 200 years, looks just as she did upon your last visit to Britannia.

speaker: Penumbra
text: "Avatar! I cannot believe 'tis thee! Thou didst come and wake me! I knew thee would!"

speaker: Penumbra
text: Suddenly, Penumbra grabs her head in pain. "Oh!" she cries. "Mine head! The pain! What is happening? What didst thou do to me?" She closes her eyes and concentrates. "There is a disturbance in the ether! I can feel my magical powers fading! Help me, <PLAYER_NAME>! Help me!!"

speaker: Penumbra
text: Penumbra is in so much pain she can barely speak. "Yes, <PLAYER_NAME>?"

speaker: Penumbra
text: "Oh! I feel so much better! The pain is ebbing. Now we may converse much more easily."

speaker: Penumbra
text: "Yes, <PLAYER_NAME>?"

speaker: Penumbra
text: "I am Penumbra. Surely thou dost remember me?"

speaker: Penumbra
text: Penumbra is in pain. "I cannot think straight whilst the ether is disturbed. I can do nothing until it is flowing smoothly again!"

speaker: Penumbra
text: "I am a practicing mage. Once I get my business going again, I should be able to sell spells and reagents. After all, I have been asleep for 200 years!"

speaker: Penumbra
text: "The ether controls all the magic in the world. When there is a disturbance in the ether, no mage can cast successful spells. A mage might even lose his mind after a long period of time! Thou must find a way to protect me from the warped ethereal waves!"

speaker: Penumbra
text: "I feel much better. The damaged ethereal waves are not striking my mind. But now we must destroy what is causing this problem!"

speaker: Penumbra
text: Penumbra thinks a moment. "I feel that the damaged ethereal waves are coming from a source very near here. I suspect there is something in a dungeon on these islands that is creating the havoc. Try Dungeon Deceit. I have a strong sense that thy goal is there."

speaker: Penumbra
text: She closes her eyes a moment.

speaker: Penumbra
text: "In my mind's eye, I see a large object shaped like a tetrahedron. I am beginning to understand what this is."

speaker: Penumbra
text: "In my mind's eye, I see a large object in a dungeon north of here. Thou dost know of what I speak, dost thou not?"

speaker: Penumbra
text: "The ether is flowing smoothly now. I thank thee, <PLAYER_NAME>. Thou hast saved all mages everywhere!"

speaker: Penumbra
text: "Thou shalt find him on the island of Terfin. Ask him about the ring."

speaker: Penumbra
text: "Please! I cannot help thee until I am protected from the damaged ether!"

speaker: Penumbra
text: "Yes, that is the shape of the thing I have seen in my mind's eye. It appears to be some type of magic generator which damages the ethereal flow."

speaker: Penumbra
text: Penumbra thinks a moment. "This generator is producing dangerous ethereal waves. Thou must find the Ethereal Ring and wear it to break the generator's defense. Now where is that ring...?"

speaker: Penumbra
text: Penumbra consults some books and cross references them with a map. "I believe that the Ethereal Ring was last in the possession of King Draxinusom of the Gargoyles. Once thou hast found the ring, thou must bring it back to me. I must perform an enchantment upon it so that it may work for thee."

speaker: Penumbra
text: "The enchanted ring shall protect thee."

speaker: Penumbra
text: "The ethereal ring must be enchanted."

speaker: Penumbra
text: "Thou hast destroyed it! All the mages thank thee!"

speaker: Penumbra
text: "I need some kind of barrier to protect me from the ethereal waves. There must be a material we could use!"

speaker: Penumbra
text: Penumbra clutches her temples. She is obviously in great pain.

speaker: Penumbra
text: "Dost thou know of a material that is impenetrable?"

speaker: Penumbra
text: "What is it?"

speaker: Penumbra
text: "Yes! That is what we need!"

speaker: Penumbra
text: "No, I do not think that will work. Oh, I cannot think, the pain is so great!"

speaker: Penumbra
text: "There must be something! Oh, I cannot think, the pain is so great!"

speaker: Penumbra
text: "Please -- canst thou find a few pieces of blackrock to set about my room? I will need four pieces! But hurry! I do not think I can last much longer! Please go!"

speaker: Penumbra
text: "Thou hast brought the blackrock! I did not think I could manage much longer! Hurry! Place the pieces on the pedestals at the north, south, east, and west ends of the room! I shall wait here!"

speaker: Penumbra
text: "But thou dost not have the blackrock! Thou must get four pieces and help me! Thou wilt need to place the pieces on the pedestals at the north, south, east, and west ends of the room! Hurry!"

speaker: Penumbra
text: "The blackrock is working! I no longer feel the painful ether!"

speaker: Penumbra
text: "It is quite a material, is it not? I imagine it could be used for many magical things."

speaker: Penumbra
text: "Thou hast the ethereal ring? Good! I must enchant it! Quickly!"

speaker: Penumbra
text: Penumbra takes the ring from you and intones a few magical words upon it. After a moment, she hands it back to you.

speaker: Penumbra
text: "Now thou must go to the generator. Be sure thou art wearing the ring! It should now protect thee from the ethereal attacks. Be aware that it is functional only near the Tetrahedron. And tell thy companions to wait out of range. Thou must enter the generator alone!"

speaker: Penumbra
text: Penumbra thinks a moment. "By the way. How didst thou happen to know to come to me about this problem?"

speaker: Penumbra
text: You tell Penumbra the story of how you need to get the hourglass enchanted.

speaker: Penumbra
text: "I see. Well, thou best be on thy way, so that thou canst indeed get thine hourglass enchanted!"

speaker: Penumbra
text: "Where is the ring? Dost thou not have it? We can do nothing without the ring! Go and find it! Please!"

speaker: Penumbra
text: "What dost thou want? I have already enchanted the ring!"

speaker: Penumbra
text: "What dost thou want? I have already enchanted the ring. It can do no more for thee!"

speaker: Penumbra
text: Penumbra waves at you and then closes her eyes in pain.

speaker: Penumbra
text: "Farewell, <PLAYER_NAME>! And good luck to thee!"

speaker: Kissme
text: This spritely fairy flutters around you, sprinkling some kind of sparkling dust on your head as she giggles.

speaker: Kissme
text: "I love thee! Yes, I do! I love thee!"

speaker: Kissme
text: "Yes, my love?" Kissme asks.

speaker: Kissme
text: "Kissme! Kissme!" She giggles.

speaker: Iolo
text: "Don't do it, <HONORIFIC>! Who knows what evil this strange creature might possess!" He inspects the sprite more closely. "Mayhaps I should try it first to be sure it is safe..."

speaker: Spark
text: "Hey, -I'll- kiss her! She doesn't scare me!"

speaker: Shamino
text: "She -doth- look rather inviting, doth she not?"

speaker: Dupre
text: "My liege has asked thee thy -name-, foul creature!"

speaker: Kissme
text: "But that -is- my name! Kissme! Kissme! It is true!"

speaker: Kissme
text: "My purpose is to spread love dust all around and welcome thee to Ambrosia! I love thee! Yes, I do!"

speaker: Kissme
text: She flutters over Shamino's head.

speaker: Kissme
text: "I love -thee-, as well!"

speaker: Shamino
text: "If only thou wert a little larger..."

speaker: Kissme
text: Then she flies around Spark.

speaker: Kissme
text: "Oooh, and I love -thee-, too!"

speaker: Spark
text: Spark blushes. "Aww, cut it out!"

speaker: Kissme
text: Kissme then flies near Dupre.

speaker: Kissme
text: "Handsome man! Handsome man! I love thee! It's true! It's true!"

speaker: Dupre
text: Dupre swats at the fairy. "Away with thee! Thou dost not love me! Thou dost not even -know- me!"

speaker: Kissme
text: Kissme glides over to Iolo and plants a big kiss on his cheek.

speaker: Kissme
text: "Yes! I love thee! Yes, I do!"

speaker: Iolo
text: Iolo makes a sour face and wipes his cheek.

speaker: Iolo
text: "Avatar, that was the sloppiest, wettest, most... -disgusting- kiss I have ever felt!"

speaker: Kissme
text: "That is where thou art! It is true! Oh, yes! Ambrosia!"

speaker: Iolo
text: "Ambrosia! Then it really does exist!"

speaker: Kissme
text: "Ambrosia, the lost isle of Britannia! Thou art really here!"

speaker: Kissme
text: "It does nothing that I know of! But it's pretty!" Kissme giggles like a child. "It's how I show thee I love thee! It's true!"

speaker: Kissme
text: "Ambrosia was hit by stones from the sky hundreds of years ago! Oh, yes indeed! The entire island was battered to bits! It is true!"

speaker: Kissme
text: "I believe it is called Caddellite. Yes, I believe it's true!"

speaker: Kissme
text: "And I -do- love thee, it is so true!"

speaker: Kissme
text: "Most of it is collected in the pit where the hydra sits. Thou shalt have to ask the hydra about it. It is true!"

speaker: Kissme
text: "The hydra is made up of three brothers -- all dragons! It is true! Thou shalt be careful not to make them angry, for they have a temper! Oh, yes indeed, they do! They are very protective of their Caddellite, so speak to them about it first!"

speaker: Kissme
text: "Ambrosia was once very beautiful! Yes, it was! All of mine ancestors lived here then! Love dust was all around, and every day was like a jewel! Yes, it's true! Yes, thou wilt!"

speaker: Kissme
text: "Oh, I must kiss thee again!"

speaker: Kissme
text: "It does not matter whether thou art male or female! No, it does not! I shall kiss thee anyway!"

speaker: Iolo
text: "No! Don't do it, <HONORIFIC>."

speaker: Spark
text: "Sheesh, here we go again!"

speaker: Shamino
text: "Hey, I think she's cute!"

speaker: Dupre
text: "If thou wouldst do it, <HONORIFIC>, do it quickly. We have not time to waste with such foolishness." Dupre looks distinctly disgusted with the whole affair.

speaker: Kissme
text: Do you allow Kissme to kiss you?

speaker: Kissme
text: Kissme places the wettest, sloppiest, oozingest, and mushiest smack you have ever felt on your mouth.

speaker: Kissme
text: "Oh, yes! That was fun! I love thee! Yes, it's true!"

speaker: Kissme
text: "I love thee anyway! It is true!" Kissme giggles and sprinkles more love dust in your hair.

speaker: Kissme
text: "Goodbye, my love! Oh yes! I love thee! It is true!"

speaker: Zelda
text: You see a woman who meets your gaze with an icy stare.

speaker: Zelda
text: "What dost thou need now?"

speaker: Zelda
text: "I am Zelda."

speaker: Zelda
text: "I am the advisor at the Lycaeum."

speaker: Zelda
text: She rolls her eyes. "The Lycaeum is the building in which thou dost stand. It is a great library designed to house a wealth of knowledge. Though the structure has changed a bit over the past two hundred years, the essence of learning has not."

speaker: Zelda
text: "Yes," she says. "My job is to manage and regulate the events in the Lycaeum. And," she adds, "provide assistance to the people here in Moonglow -- when they need it!"

speaker: Zelda
text: "I am in charge of maintaining the reading areas and bringing in new books. In addition, I help organize special group sessions for Jillian's tutorials and set up educational entertainment programs."

speaker: Zelda
text: "I have not the time for these petty geography questions. Check an atlas!"

speaker: Zelda
text: "I have little time for this," she sighs. "I know only the Lycaeum head and his twin, Brion, at all well. The trainer also studies here in the Lycaeum." She looks up at the ceiling, as if reading from an invisible, overhead list.

speaker: Zelda
text: "Thou dost already know about Penumbra. Mariah is here. If thou wishest to know about a member of The Fellowship, ask the clerk there. Otherwise," she eyes you coldly, "let me return to my duties." As an afterthought, she adds, "And keep thy voice down. People are trying to read."

speaker: Zelda
text: "Well, they say she used to be an adept mage, but all I see is a woman who wanders around complimenting the furniture. Thou mayest speak to her if thou wishest, but I doubt she will make sense to thee. And do not disorganize the shelves while looking for her!"

speaker: Zelda
text: "Jillian? She is very well-behaved. Also quiet and tidy. I believe she is an excellent scholar. If thou art going to seek her out, try not to overturn any shelves. Some new books have just arrived and I have not finished placing all of them."

speaker: Zelda
text: "Yes, they arrived not long ago, including the recently rediscovered copy of DeMaria and Spector's work,`The Avatar Adventures.' If thou canst avoid creating too much of a disturbance, I recommend it to thee."

speaker: Zelda
text: "If I tell thee this last thing, wilt thou depart so I may return to my job?"

speaker: Zelda
text: "We discovered the tome in the lower depths of the basement. We have no way to account for the accuracy of the contents, but have noticed many parallels between the events in the work and the events in Britannia's recent history."

speaker: Zelda
text: "The book is a copy of the Avatar's diary, written about two hundred years ago during <PRONOUN> most recent visit to Britannia. Of course," she smiles sardonically, "it has been annotated by others."

speaker: Zelda
text: "It was recently published to give the general public more courage and confidence."

speaker: Zelda
text: "And now, goodbye."

speaker: Zelda
text: "Fine."

speaker: Zelda
text: She shakes her head, muttering, "Why doth <PRONOUN> waste my time in this manner?" Looking back up at you, she says, "Penumbra is the sage who put herself to sleep two centuries ago. Rumor has it that only the Avatar can awaken her."

speaker: Zelda
text: "Nelson is very competent, although a little eccentric. I do wish he would refrain from showing off his collection of trinkets to everyone who enters the building. It always makes such a commotion."

speaker: Zelda
text: Her chilly expression melts away. "Brion," she says, smiling, "is very open-minded and idealistic. He knows the heavens quite well." She looks up to emphasize `heavens.' "I find him very attractive. But, I do not know how to convey mine intentions." She turns away, shyly.

speaker: Zelda
text: "Unless, perchance, <HONORIFIC> wilt aid me?" she asks, hopefully. "Wilt thou agree to tell him for me, <HONORIFIC>?"

speaker: Zelda
text: "Thank thee, <HONORIFIC>. Thank thee." She blushes.

speaker: Zelda
text: "For thy kindness, I will give thee this white potion I found once while straightening the basement."

speaker: Zelda
text: Her cold glare returns. "Very well."

speaker: Zelda
text: She looks down for a moment. "I thought as much." As she raises her head, tears are visible in her eyes. "I thank thee for trying."

speaker: Zelda
text: "Nelson? I never really thought about him." She shrugs. "Hmm, I suppose he is not a bad second best. I will try," she says, smiling.

speaker: Zelda
text: "Well, his brother, Brion, is quite attractive, I think."

speaker: Zelda
text: "Good day."

speaker: Mariah
text: You see your old friend Mariah.

speaker: Mariah
text: "Yes, <PLAYER_NAME>? How may I help thee?" Mariah greets you.

speaker: Mariah
text: "Yes, <HONORIFIC>?" Mariah smiles, a trifle too sweetly.

speaker: Iolo
text: "Surely thou dost recognize thine old companion, Mariah?"

speaker: Mariah
text: "Hast thou already forgotten me, <PLAYER_NAME>? I am Mariah."

speaker: Mariah
text: "I sell spells, reagents, and sometimes a few potions here at the Lycaeum. Dost thou wish to buy any of these, <PLAYER_NAME>?"

speaker: Mariah
text: "I am afraid, <PLAYER_NAME>, that I have a very meager selection."

speaker: Mariah
text: She shakes her head sadly. "I have not been `myself' for so long that I no longer recognize this town." Her eyes widen.

speaker: Mariah
text: "There are so many buildings around the Lycaeum now, hast thou seen them?"

speaker: Mariah
text: She pauses, looking at you.

speaker: Mariah
text: "By the way, old friend. I assume thou art responsible for returning the ether to its normal state. I thank thee."

speaker: Mariah
text: "Fair days ahead, friend <PLAYER_NAME>."

speaker: Iolo
text: "Surely thou dost recognize thine old companion, Mariah?"

speaker: Mariah
text: "Yes, dost thou not recognize me?" She pauses, glaring at you. "But who art thou, and where are my pastries?"

speaker: Mariah
text: "Yes, thou mayest tell me thy name," she says, glancing around the building. "Are not the many books beautiful?"

speaker: Mariah
text: She smiles. "I have a very important job, I do. My, are not those shelves lovely? So neat and orderly." She looks back at you.

speaker: Mariah
text: "Be careful! The ink wells are full, and the quills so sharp." She giggles.

speaker: Mariah
text: "Are not they the neatest, most orderly, and well-kept shelves thou hast seen? They do an excellent job of maintaining them!"

speaker: Mariah
text: "They are always so full and ready for use. They are so good about keeping them filled and clean!"

speaker: Mariah
text: "Oh, yes, they are quite sharp! Always there when one needs to scribe a missive. They do an excellent job of having many ready at a moment's notice!"

speaker: Mariah
text: "Yes, they do!" Her face turns sad. "But I only sell."

speaker: Mariah
text: "Yes," she agrees, "I do indeed sell. I even spell. In fact, I even sell spells! But, if thou desirest reagents, thou art out of luck, for I only sell those during one of the seven weekdays. Wouldst thou like to know which day?"

speaker: Mariah
text: "What a lovely set of books thou must have! I have just the item for thee to match thy shelves -- a potion. If thou wilt buy a spell or reagent from me, I will sell thee a potion for only its normal price!"

speaker: Mariah
text: "Why, today. Thou art in luck. Buy a spell."

speaker: Mariah
text: "Certainly, come back anytime and buy."

speaker: Grod
text: The troll snarls at you, obviously displeased at your presence.

speaker: Grod
text: "What you want?" asks Grod.

speaker: Grod
text: "I Grod. Why you want know? Is voice unhappy?"

speaker: Grod
text: He seems truly worried.

speaker: Grod
text: "I will do job better. I promise! I beat harder and more often!"

speaker: Anton
text: "Thank thee ever so much, <HONORIFIC>," says <VAR> sarcastically.

speaker: Sullivan
text: "Now, now, Anton, the nice person was simply answering a question."

speaker: Grod
text: "Good. I do my job good!"

speaker: Grod
text: "I Grod. Who you?"

speaker: Grod
text: "I not know you." He shrugs.

speaker: Grod
text: "Funny name. But, all humans have funny names." He shrugs.

speaker: Grod
text: "The Avatar?" He begins laughing. "The Avatar not been here for...," he begins counting on his fingers. After several attempts, he gives up, saying, "for many years!"

speaker: Grod
text: "You no Avatar."

speaker: Grod
text: "I torture prisoners," he says, thumping his chest proudly.

speaker: Spark
text: Spark's eyes light up.

speaker: Spark
text: "Torture? Wow! He quickly looks at you and changes expressions."

speaker: Spark
text: "I, er, mean, that is very awful."

speaker: Grod
text: "Want to help?"

speaker: Grod
text: He points to one of the prisoners.

speaker: Grod
text: "He not fun like the other. Torture other first."

speaker: Sullivan
text: "What? No, that's all right, <HONORIFIC>. Torture me, first."

speaker: Anton
text: "Yes, <HONORIFIC>. Torture him first."

speaker: Sullivan
text: "I thank thee," he says to the other.

speaker: Grod
text: "Go ahead," says Grod.

speaker: Grod
text: He hands you a whip.

speaker: Grod
text: "You too wimpy to use whip!"

speaker: Grod
text: "No one here to abuse." He appears disappointed.

speaker: Grod
text: "You make funny joke. Go ahead, torture."

speaker: Grod
text: "Yes," he nods. "I belong, too. I strive for unity. I be worthy for my reward. And I trust my brother."

speaker: Grod
text: " He smiles, obviously pleased with himself."

speaker: Grod
text: "Big group, many people. You should join!"

speaker: Grod
text: "You don't know?" He frowns.

speaker: Grod
text: "You should learn before the voice become angry!"

speaker: Grod
text: "Good, join. See Abraham or Danag about join."

speaker: Grod
text: "None here at the moment..." he appears truly disconcerted.

speaker: Grod
text: "There one!" he says, pointing to a man.

speaker: Grod
text: "There another one!" he says, indicating the other man.

speaker: Sullivan
text: "How art thou today, <HONORIFIC>?" he says, smiling.

speaker: Grod
text: "Much fun! Prisoners scream loudly."

speaker: Grod
text: "Except that one. He not scream. He just talk. And talk. I get so bored I get mad. So I torture more. And," he throws up his hands, "he just talk more! I no know what to do."

speaker: Iolo
text: "That is terrible, <PLAYER_NAME>. We must command him to stop!"

speaker: Grod
text: "I try make him stop. But he talk and talk. You try? Maybe he stop."

speaker: Grod
text: "Oh, no! Grod love job! Grod never stop. You go away now."

speaker: Grod
text: "Come back and visit Grod. Hear victims squeal!"

speaker: Cubolt
text: "<HONORIFIC>? Thou, too, hast joined the evil organization? But how is this possible? Canst thou not see their tenets vie with the very virtues themselves? Dost thou not feel more like a sheep than a man? I am truly sorry, for if one of Britannia's greatest heroes has fallen in with such filth, then there is no hope for our great land!" He turns away in disgust.

speaker: Cubolt
text: You see a man with an unhappy look upon his face.

speaker: Cubolt
text: Cubolt looks up. "Yes, <HONORIFIC>?"

speaker: Cubolt
text: "I am Cubolt of Moonglow."

speaker: Cubolt
text: "I am a farmer, <HONORIFIC>. I manage my farm with the help of Tolemac, my brother, and Morz, our family friend."

speaker: Cubolt
text: "The city occupies the entire island now, including the Lycaeum. Most of the residents still live south, though. We are due east of Britain proper."

speaker: Cubolt
text: "My brother and I have known Morz for most of our lives. He is very friendly when he is not too busy worrying about his stutter. Unfortunately, he listens to Tolemac too often."

speaker: Cubolt
text: Cubolt looks down at the ground, shaking his head sadly. "He started when he was five years old. He and my brother were wrestling in the back of a wagon driven by his parents. They hit a bump and he fell out -- and landed on his head. Ever since, he hath had his stutter." He looks back up at you. "The odd thing is, neither he nor Tolemac remember the accident. Or at least, Tolemac doth not. I cannot convince Morz to talk about it."

speaker: Cubolt
text: "Zelda, the clerk at the Lycaeum, would be the best person to talk to about Moonglow's residents. Or the bartender, though I do not know his name. I know that the Observatory head and the Lycaeum head are twins, but I have never met either of them. I do know that thou dost not want to talk to Rankin or Balayna at The Fellowship. They are ill news to our once-pleasant city."

speaker: Cubolt
text: "He is my younger brother. Need I say more? I am a little concerned about him though. I am used to his rebellious behavior, but recently he has joined The Fellowship. That frightens me. They frighten me. I have tried to get him to come to his senses, but he is too busy enjoying making me worry to listen. Also, he is trying to get Morz to join. I wish I could get him to reconsider."

speaker: Cubolt
text: He spits on the ground. "A bane to Britannia is what The Fellowship is. They have some odd philosophy that teaches thee to forget who thou art and follow them. The process is dehumanizing, and I think it meshes poorly with the eight virtues. Not only that, but their leader here in Moonglow has persuaded Tolemac to join."

speaker: Cubolt
text: "Unfortunately, Tolemac will not listen to me. However," he begins to smile hopefully, "he just might listen to thee, <HONORIFIC>. Perhaps thou couldst talk him into reconverting. I would very much appreciate that! Perhaps," he adds, "thou couldst also ask Morz not to join."

speaker: Cubolt
text: "Take care, <HONORIFIC>."

speaker: Balayna
text: Glaring, she puts a finger over her lips, indicating that you should be silent.

speaker: Balayna
text: "I cannot talk now, I must hurry to the Fellowship meeting."

speaker: Balayna
text: You see a woman with a very serious look about her.

speaker: Balayna
text: "How may I be of assistance, <PLAYER_NAME>?"

speaker: Balayna
text: She gives you a suspicious look. "My name is Balayna."

speaker: Balayna
text: "I am the clerk for the Moonglow branch of The Fellowship."

speaker: Balayna
text: "It is my job to keep records during the meetings, and to administrate the decisions of this branch."

speaker: Balayna
text: "What's this?" she asks, taking the vial from you. She opens it up and sniffs. "Very good quality. I wonder why he..." she clutches her throat and gasps. You notice a wispy smoke rise from the top of the vial now spilling out of her hands. Choking, she falls to the ground, and dies.

speaker: Balayna
text: "I am afraid I must first see what thou art referring to before I can answer thy question."

speaker: Balayna
text: She stares at you suspiciously.

speaker: Balayna
text: "We have our meetings at 9 at night -- the customary time. After Rankin's lecture, we all discuss the wonderful aspects of our life that have been enhanced by The Fellowship."

speaker: Balayna
text: "This seemed to be an... appropriate place to start up a branch. There are many good citizens here in Moonglow."

speaker: Balayna
text: She appears surprised at the statement. "Well, I believe that many of the people are of strong mind and character. They are just the kind of people The Fellowship needs to go out and spread guidance and prosperity throughout Britannia."

speaker: Balayna
text: "Many of the people lack the discipline required to reach their highest potential."

speaker: Balayna
text: "The Fellowship is designed to enrich the lives of everyone who resides in this fair land."

speaker: Balayna
text: "I am so busy with my duties that I know very few people here. Phearcy, the bartender, is an outstanding member of the community, as is the farmer, Tolemac. Tolemac's friend, Morz, though shy, is well spoken of. Also, Morz has a brother." She glances up, thoughtfully. "Or is he Tolemac's brother?"

speaker: Balayna
text: "I am not positive whose brother he is, but I do know that I do not know that much about him," she sniffs.

speaker: Balayna
text: "Our Branch has been open here in Moonglow for approximately half a decade. Rankin has been here the entire time, but I started at this branch only a few months ago."

speaker: Balayna
text: "The Fellowship is a society of spiritual seekers who strive to reach the highest levels of human potential. We espouse neo-realism through the Triad of Inner Strength. In addition, we manage and organize many festivals and also operate a shelter for the needy."

speaker: Balayna
text: "Rankin is the branch head here in Moonglow. He can answer thy questions."

speaker: Balayna
text: "The Triad is basically three principles that, when applied in unison, enable the individual to better reach creativity, satisfaction, and success in life."

speaker: Balayna
text: "The three principles are: Strive for Unity, Trust thy Brother -- and sister -- and Worthiness precedes Reward."

speaker: Balayna
text: "Essentially, this means that cooperation among people is not only a desirable means for reaching human potential in itself, but it also facilitates the entire process."

speaker: Balayna
text: "This tenet illustrates that, as people, we are all the same, and that neither hatred nor fear of one another is productive. In fact, it is destructive."

speaker: Balayna
text: "This basically means that individuals should strive to be worthy of that which they want in life. It is often misquoted as `thou dost receive what thou dost deserve,' but that tends to have negative connotations."

speaker: Balayna
text: "He is the branch head here in Moonglow."

speaker: Balayna
text: She glances around cautiously. "Thou art travelling through the city, correct? And eventually going to visit another city -- Britain, perhaps?" She shoots another glance, apparently checking for something. Finally, she leans forward, speaking with a whisper.

speaker: Balayna
text: "I am unsure whether Rankin is worthy of his position. I heard him talking to the new member, Tolemac, just before Rankin persuaded him to join. He admitted to having doubts about The Fellowship. He told Tolemac that he thought, perhaps, The Fellowship encouraged its members to be nothing more than sheep, and that those really `in charge' were charlatans, in it simply for the money. What does thou think about that?" She leans back.

speaker: Balayna
text: "Goodbye, <PLAYER_NAME>. Remember what I have told thee."

speaker: Balayna
text: "Goodbye, <PLAYER_NAME>."

speaker: Tolemac
text: "Get thee away! I'll hear no more of thy lies!"

speaker: Tolemac
text: "I am trying to pay attention!" he says, glaring at you.

speaker: Tolemac
text: "Sorry, <HONORIFIC>, I cannot talk now. I must get to the Fellowship meeting!"

speaker: Tolemac
text: You see a friendly-looking farmer.

speaker: Tolemac
text: "Good day, <HONORIFIC>."

speaker: Tolemac
text: "I am called Tolemac, <HONORIFIC>."

speaker: Tolemac
text: "I help my brother tend our farm here in Moonglow."

speaker: Tolemac
text: "My brother is Cubolt." He frowns for a moment. "He can be a bit overbearing at times, trying to `take care' of me. But," he shrugs, "he means well, perhaps. I know I've caused him a bit of trouble every now and then," he says with a grin, "but he deserves it."

speaker: Tolemac
text: "Yes, <HONORIFIC>. That is the name of the town thou art in. Dost thou have questions about the townspeople?"

speaker: Tolemac
text: "I know only a few people here, <HONORIFIC>. My brother, Cubolt, runs the farm with me. Morz helps us, too -- we've known him for many years. And now that I've joined The Fellowship, I've met a few more people. Rankin is branch head here in Moonglow, and Balayna is his assistant. If thou dost want to know about other people, thou mayest want to ask the bartender. His name is Phearcy."

speaker: Tolemac
text: "Rankin is very intelligent. He is the one who persuaded me to join The Fellowship. I have much respect for him."

speaker: Tolemac
text: "She is the branch clerk. Most of the time, she is friendly. Sometimes, however, she seems a little cold."

speaker: Tolemac
text: "Morz and I grew up together. He is very sensitive about his stutter, though, so I would not bring it up."

speaker: Tolemac
text: "It is difficult to get him to talk about it. I think it was caused by an accident he had when he was a child. I barely remember the incident. My brother might remember more."

speaker: Tolemac
text: "Rankin or Balayna would be the best ones to ask, <HONORIFIC>, but I can tell thee our main tenets."

speaker: Tolemac
text: "We believe strongly in neo-realism, which is a form of optimistic outlook which may be reached through the triad of inner strength."

speaker: Tolemac
text: "I am hoping that soon I will be able to hear the    voice that comes with meeting one's higher potential."

speaker: Tolemac
text: "Also, <HONORIFIC>, The Fellowship sponsors many feasts and festivals. I strongly recommend that thou ask Rankin about joining."

speaker: Tolemac
text: "Reconvert? Why would I want to do that? Did my brother request this? He has always had a problem with letting me make mine own decisions. Nay, <HONORIFIC>. I will not abandon my beliefs. The Fellowship has done too much for my life."

speaker: Tolemac
text: "And to think thou art a fellow member. There is no unity in thy speech!"

speaker: Tolemac
text: "'Til next time, <HONORIFIC>."

speaker: Morz
text: The man before you shyly looks away.

speaker: Morz
text: "H-H-How m-m-may I h-h-help thee, <HONORIFIC>?"

speaker: Morz
text: "What st-st-stutter?"  He turns to leave.

speaker: Morz
text: He points to the ground. "That is here!"

speaker: Morz
text: "M-M-Morz."

speaker: Morz
text: "I work with C-C-Cubolt, f-f-farming here."

speaker: Morz
text: "M-M-Moonglow."

speaker: Morz
text: "That is n-n-not f-f-funny!" He blushes, and angrily turns away.

speaker: Morz
text: "He is T-T-Tolemac's older br-br-brother. I t-t-trust him."

speaker: Morz
text: "T-T-Tolemac is m-m-my f-f-friend. I've kn-kn-known h-h-him f-f-for a long t-t-time. He just joined The F-F-Fellowship. He wants m-m-me t-t-to join, t-t-too."

speaker: Morz
text: "T-T-Tolemac says they d-d-do m-m-many g-g-good things and they would h-h-help m-m-me m-m-make f-f-friends m-m-more easily. C-C-Cubolt thinks they're b-b-bad. I d-d-do not kn-kn-know what t-t-to d-d-do."

speaker: Morz
text: "Thou d-d-dost n-n-not think I should join? C-C-Cubolt does not want m-m-me t-t-to either. I s-s-suppose I won't. I thank thee."

speaker: Morz
text: "B-b-bye."

speaker: Jillian
text: You see a young woman with an intellectual bearing.

speaker: Jillian
text: "Greetings, <PLAYER_NAME>. As usual, I have much to do. However, I can spare a moment for thee if necessary."

speaker: Jillian
text: "I am Jillian, <HONORIFIC>."

speaker: Jillian
text: "I am a scholar, <HONORIFIC>. I also tutor and train those who seek knowledge here in Moonglow."

speaker: Jillian
text: "The town occupies almost the entire island of the same name. The island is located due east and a few degrees south of the city of Britain."

speaker: Jillian
text: "Long ago there was a small continent -- an island really -- called Ambrosia. However, meteorites struck it, destroying its primary city. The island was located in the North East sea. I suppose the ruins still lie far beneath the rubble."

speaker: Jillian
text: "My price is 35 gold for each training session. Art thou willing to pay that?"

speaker: Jillian
text: "Then I really should return to my studies."

speaker: Jillian
text: "A better time to train thee would be when I am in my study."

speaker: Jillian
text: "Fare thee well, <PLAYER_NAME>," she says, returning to her previous activity.

speaker: Effrem
text: You see a man with a sour expression on his face holding a baby boy. As he sees you, his face brightens.

speaker: Effrem
text: "Hello again, <PLAYER_NAME>. I am here as usual, taking care of little Mikhail." Effrem grimaces.

speaker: Effrem
text: "I am Effrem, <HONORIFIC>. I am but a simple resident of Moonglow."

speaker: Effrem
text: "What is thy name?"

speaker: Effrem
text: "Hello, <PLAYER_NAME>." He turns to the baby.

speaker: Effrem
text: "Say `hello' to <PLAYER_NAME>, Mikhail."

speaker: Effrem
text: "Fine, <HONORIFIC>, if that is the title by which thou dost wish to be called." He looks at the infant. "The <VAR> is quite a snob is <PRONOUN> not, Mikhail?"

speaker: Effrem
text: "Aha, the Avatar, thou sayest. Whatever thou thinkest...." He turns to the baby.

speaker: Effrem
text: "This poor person here wants to be the Avatar. Too bad there is only one Avatar, eh Mikhail?"

speaker: Effrem
text: "Me? I do not have a job. Not a real one like my wife has. All I do all day is watch over my little Mikhail, here." He turns to look at the baby, taking on a patronizing tone. "Yes, I take care of thee, do I not? Yes, I do. I sure do." He kisses the boy and then looks back up at you,	embarrassed.

speaker: Effrem
text: "Where was I? Oh yes. All I do is take care of the boy. What I should be doing is working, not staying at home. That should be Jillian's job. She belongs here at home, not me."

speaker: Effrem
text: "That is the name of my son. 'Tis a good name, yes?"

speaker: Effrem
text: "My wife? Jillian? She's the scholar. She is a very good one, too. Not that I could not have done well. I could have. Better, in fact. But it is not worth arguing about now. She has her occupation, even if I do not have one. I should have a job, though. Dost thou not agree, <HONORIFIC>? This is not what a man ought to be doing. Staying at home raising the children, like this. 'Tis a disgrace!"

speaker: Effrem
text: He begins to stroke the infant's small tuft of hair.

speaker: Jillian
text: "Now Effrem! Thou knowest perfectly well what we agreed when little Mikhail was born. Thou shouldst be ashamed, talking such nonsense."

speaker: Effrem
text: He raises his shoulders, making him appear quite sheepish.

speaker: Effrem
text: "What about Moonglow?" He shrugs, "'Tis a fair town, but a little too crowded these days. I hear it was a much nicer place back when Moonglow was separate from the Lycaeum. Much smaller."

speaker: Effrem
text: "This place is too large to really get to know anyone. Not that I have had much of an opportunity, having to stay at home and take care of my son." He looks down at the boy, smiles, and tickles the baby's nose.

speaker: Effrem
text: "This is not a job for a man. My wife should be home with the boy, not me. I should be out earning a living. That is what I ought to be doing!"

speaker: Effrem
text: "Leaving so soon? Fine, leave me with the baby. Go on, leave me. Just like my wife!"

speaker: Effrem
text: "Leaving so soon? Ah, that's all right, <HONORIFIC>. I understand, thou hast real man things to do."

speaker: Chad
text: You see a lithe-looking fighter smile in your direction.

speaker: Chad
text: Chad smiles. "Hello, <PLAYER_NAME>. I hope thy days are going well."

speaker: Chad
text: "Chad, at thy service, <HONORIFIC>. And what is thy name?"

speaker: Chad
text: "Greetings, <PLAYER_NAME>. I am at thy service."

speaker: Chad
text: "Greetings, <HONORIFIC>." He shrugs.

speaker: Chad
text: "Of course, of course," he smiles. "I should have realized that thou wert the Avatar. Why, it must have been, oh, at least, two weeks since thy last visit!" He winks.

speaker: Shamino
text: "Thou art a fool! Cannot thy feeble eyes see this is the Avatar?"

speaker: Chad
text: "Yes, yes! I can see that," he laughs. "Then I must be Iolo!"

speaker: Shamino
text: "No, rogue! He is Iolo!" He nods to Iolo. "Thou... art a blind idiot!"

speaker: Shamino
text: "No, rogue, thou art a blind idiot!"

speaker: Chad
text: "I teach expertise with light weapons here in Moonglow."

speaker: Chad
text: "Dost thou want the location of the city or to know about the townspeople?"

speaker: Chad
text: "Moonglow is on an island directly east of the border between Britain and Paws."

speaker: Chad
text: "The person to ask for that information would be Phearcy, the bartender. All I know are other bar patrons: Tolemac and Morz, two farmers."

speaker: Chad
text: "Yes, I train people. But only during the day. Now, 'tis time for drink!"

speaker: Chad
text: "Wilt thou pay the 45 gold for the training session?"

speaker: Chad
text: "Well, mayhap next time thou wilt be willing."

speaker: Chad
text: "Remember, always keeps thy wits about and thy blade ready."

speaker: Elad
text: The man looks at you through smiling eyes.

speaker: Elad
text: Elad bows in your direction.

speaker: Elad
text: "My pleasure to see thee again."

speaker: Elad
text: "Elad is my name, <HONORIFIC>."

speaker: Elad
text: "I am the healer of the residents of this community."

speaker: Elad
text: "Moonglow is mine home. I have lived in this town for mine entire life. But I am weary of my life here. 'Tis time, I think, to move on. If only I did not have such strong ties here."

speaker: Elad
text: He sighs sadly.

speaker: Elad
text: "There is a traveller visiting from Yew. He has seen many exciting things in Britannia. I enjoy listening to his many tales of adventure."

speaker: Elad
text: "His name is Addom. While he is in town, I am letting him stay in one of my beds."

speaker: Elad
text: "Yes, I sell mine healing services to those who need them."

speaker: Elad
text: "Perhaps thou couldst come for healing when I am working in my shop."

speaker: Elad
text: "My patients here in Moonglow. Who will help them if not I?"

speaker: Elad
text: "There are many people in Moonglow. My father once told me that the town was much smaller during his time. In fact, he said that Moonglow used to be separate from the Lycaeum!"

speaker: Elad
text: "But, I digress. Thou didst ask about the people. I know most of the residents here. Dost thou want to know about the Lycaeum, the observatory, The Fellowship, the farmers, the trainer, or the tavern?"

speaker: Elad
text: "The Lycaeum is run by a kind man named Nelson. His advisor is Zelda. Do not break any rules in her presence or thou wilt receive a sharp reprimand!"

speaker: Elad
text: "Jillian also studies there. She can teach thee many things. And do not worry about Mariah. She is harmless if thou wilt but leave her be."

speaker: Elad
text: "The head there is Brion. He is the twin of the head of the Lycaeum. I like him, although he and his brother are both a little eccentric."

speaker: Elad
text: "I know these people least of all. The branch opened here about five years ago under the direction of a man named Rankin. A few months ago, a clerk joined him. Her name is Balayna."

speaker: Elad
text: "Cubolt owns the farm. He manages it with his younger brother Tolemac and their friend Morz. I am not positive, but I believe Tolemac recently joined The Fellowship."

speaker: Elad
text: "Phearcy tends the bar there. He is another good person with whom thou shouldst speak about the townspeople. However, he enjoys gossip, and may be a bit single-minded."

speaker: Elad
text: "The trainer is named Chad. I believe he specializes in swift, skillful fighting, with knives and swords and such. See him if thou wishest to improve thy skills."

speaker: Elad
text: "Leaving so soon, <HONORIFIC>? Very well, may thy journeys be filled with prosperity."

speaker: Elad
text: He sighs. Suddenly, his face brightens.

speaker: Elad
text: "Wait! Perhaps I could join thee?"

speaker: Elad
text: He quickly stands up, smiling. Then, just as suddenly, his smile fades.

speaker: Elad
text: "No. I cannot. I have far too many things to do, too many people to care for. Perhaps in the future?"

speaker: Elad
text: He forces a smile.

speaker: Elad
text: "I hope when we meet next time, <HONORIFIC>, I will have the opportunity to join thee. Pleasant journey, my friend."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "Sorry, <HONORIFIC>, I may talk to thee later. But now I wish to pay attention to the meeting."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "Sorry, <HONORIFIC>, I must get to the Fellowship meeting!"

speaker: Phearcy
text: "Why, Hello, Sir Dupre. Things fare well I trust?"

speaker: Dupre
text: "Greetings, fair Phearcy. Yes, thank thee, things are well."

speaker: Phearcy
text: You see a man who gives you a friendly smile.

speaker: Phearcy
text: "How may I help thee, <HONORIFIC>?" asks Phearcy.

speaker: Phearcy
text: "Hast thou discovered the reason for Zelda's moods?"

speaker: Phearcy
text: "Excellent. Thou canst tell me while I get thy refreshment." As he prepares your meal, you tell him what you know about Zelda and Brion.

speaker: Phearcy
text: "Too bad, <HONORIFIC>. When thou art carrying less weighty things I shall give thee thy jerky."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "And when thy load is lighter, then I can give thee thy beverages."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "'Tis a shame, <HONORIFIC>. Perhaps thou wilt know next time."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "I am Phearcy, at thy service." He gives a short bow.

speaker: Phearcy
text: "I am the bartender here in Moonglow."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "Oh, thou referest to this?" he asks, pointing to his medallion. "Thou hast not heard of The Fellowship? I strongly recommend that thou speakest with Rankin or Balayna at the branch office. The Fellowship has done many things for our town, if not for all of Britannia. I am a firm believer in neo-realism."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "That is the fundamental principle of The Fellowship. It is composed of the triad of inner strength, which is strive for unity, trust thy brother, and... one other one.... Oh, yes, thou dost get what thou deservest, or some such."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "Thou wants to know about someone in the town? Thou hast asked the right person. I know all about the residents here in Moonglow. I would be happy to tell thee about any of the shop keepers, scholars, or farmers who live here. Or art thou interested in the trainer, healer, mage, or Fellowship leaders?"

speaker: Phearcy
text: "Ah, the learned scholars. I can tell thee about Brion, Nelson, Zelda, and Jillian."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "Dost thou want to know about the one in charge or his clerk?"

speaker: Phearcy
text: "Ah, yes, Mariah is very nice."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "She can sell thee many spells."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "But I am more interested in discussing Zelda."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "She is a tailor. Lovely woman, that Carlyn. She minds the bar when I go to the Fellowship meetings at night."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "But I would rather discuss Zelda."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "Wonderful scholar. Very nice woman. Married to Effrem."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "But I am more interested in discussing Zelda."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "Friendly fellow -- I like him."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "He stays home to care for their son."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "But I am more interested in discussing Brion."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "Chad is a friendly fellow -- I like him."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "But I would rather discuss Brion."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "Tolemac and Cubolt are brothers. With Morz's help, they run a farm."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "But I would prefer to talk about Brion."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "Friendly fellow -- I like him. His name is Elad."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "Sadly, his true desire is to leave Moonglow in search of adventure. But he will not leave, for he feels too much obligation for his patients." Phearcy shrugs.

speaker: Phearcy
text: "Perhaps not without reason."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "But Brion is more interesting to me."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "He is Brion's twin brother."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "Speaking of that, I would like to discuss Brion."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "Rankin is in charge of the entire local branch. If thou hast any questions about The Fellowship, he can answer them."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "If thou hast any questions about The Fellowship, Balayna can answer them."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "Well, as thou dost know, Brion is the head of Observatory, and Zelda, the advisor at the Lyceaum, is in love with him."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "Ah, so thou dost wonder, too. All I know is that every time someone mentions Brion's name to Zelda, her serious expression changes to a smile."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "I have a deal for thee. Find out what their story is, and I will give thee and thy friends a free meal and drink. Thou canst find Brion at the observatory and Zelda at the Lyceaum."

speaker: Phearcy
text: "Food or drink, <HONORIFIC>?"

speaker: Phearcy
text: "Remember! Tell them thou didst eat at the Friendly Knave!"

speaker: Addom
text: You see a handsome,hardened, muscular man who, surprisingly, bears a friendly smile on his face.

speaker: Addom
text: "Please, <HONORIFIC>. Join me for some company."

speaker: Addom
text: "I am called Addom, <HONORIFIC>."

speaker: Addom
text: "I travel the world in search of rare and unique items to sell to museums. I am not a resident of Moonglow."

speaker: Addom
text: "I have been all over Britannia, <HONORIFIC>. Nothing about the land frightens me any longer."

speaker: Addom
text: He grins. "The same is not true of some of the residents."

speaker: Addom
text: "'Twas a joke, <HONORIFIC>."

speaker: Addom
text: "I have found many odd artifacts. Many of the things thou hast seen in The Music Hall and the Lycaeum have been brought to them by me."

speaker: Addom
text: "In fact, <HONORIFIC>, I have this unique crystal I found on the mainland near Jhelom that I am hoping will fetch a fair price from Nelson."

speaker: Addom
text: He pulls out a small clear crystal and shows it to you.

speaker: Addom
text: The facets gleam in the light.

speaker: Addom
text: "He is in charge of the Lycaeum. He loves trinkets and rarities."

speaker: Addom
text: "I am afraid, <HONORIFIC>, that I know nothing about this fair city. I reside in Yew with my wife, Penni, who is the trainer there."

speaker: Addom
text: "Actually, <HONORIFIC>, I have met two people here, other than Nelson."

speaker: Addom
text: "I have come to know the bartender and the healer."

speaker: Addom
text: "Phearcy is quite friendly. But he does love to gossip. He has offered me a deal whereby I might earn free meals if I can discover why Nelson's assistant reacts differently to some man, or something like that. I am not going to bother, but pray, do not tell Phearcy that!"

speaker: Addom
text: "Elad is very generous. In fact, he is letting me sleep in one of his spare beds while I am in town. His only charge," he laughs, "is the stories I tell him about mine adventures."

speaker: Addom
text: "Not a bad trade if I say so myself," he shrugs.

speaker: Addom
text: "She teaches close-quarter combat. Everything I needed to know to survive on my journeys I learned from her."

speaker: Addom
text: "Dost thou mean this?" He pulls a small, clear, multi-faceted gem from a pouch beneath his cloak. "I just found this recently. I was hoping to sell it to the Lycaeum, but, alas, they have no use for it. Dost thou want it, perhaps?" he asks, hopefully. "I will sell it to thee for 20 gold."

speaker: Addom
text: "I thank thee."

speaker: Addom
text: "I am truly sorry, <HONORIFIC>, but thou dost not have enough room."

speaker: Addom
text: "I am truly sorry, <HONORIFIC>, but thou dost not have enough gold."

speaker: Addom
text: "Very well," he sighs, disappointed.

speaker: Addom
text: "May thy days be always pleasant, <HONORIFIC>."

speaker: Frank
text: "I think thou dost ask too many questions."

speaker: Frank
text: You see a fox standing on his hind legs, staring directly at you.

speaker: Frank
text: "My name is Frank, devout follower of honesty." He makes a slight bow.

speaker: Frank
text: "And who wouldst thou be?"

speaker: Frank
text: "It is good that thou didst tell me. One should always be honest in one's dealings with others. By the by, thy voice crackles too much."

speaker: Frank
text: "I am sorry to see that thou art not trusting enough to reveal thy name." He shrugs. "By the by, thy voice crackles too much."

speaker: Frank
text: "I," he says, "am on a quest. A quest for honesty." He sniffs the air, and then turns to you.

speaker: Frank
text: "By the by, thou mightest have more friends if thou didst bathe a little more often."

speaker: Frank
text: "Yes, as in `take a bath.' I must inform thee that thou dost truly stink!"

speaker: Frank
text: "Speaking of thy friends, I have heard that thy companion, Dupre, is a drunken sot."

speaker: Dupre
text: "Hey, I don't think --"

speaker: Frank
text: "Yes, from what I have been told, that Dupre has no will when confronted by a tankard of, well, anything."

speaker: Frank
text: "As a matter of fact, thou hast fairly poor taste in companions overall."

speaker: Frank
text: "I am glad thou didst ask, <HONORIFIC>. Thy friend, Iolo, charges far too much for his bows. Perhaps thou couldst have a chat with him."

speaker: Iolo
text: "Too much? What dost thou mean, too --"

speaker: Frank
text: "His bows and crossbows just aren't of the quality that is worth the kind of gold he charges."

speaker: Frank
text: He takes a step back.

speaker: Frank
text: "Gads! Thy breath could gag an ox. Thou shouldst consider taking better care of thy teeth, or thy fellows will leave thee."

speaker: Frank
text: "That is the reason for thine offensive mouth odor. I have not seen anything that yellow since the time thy fellow Shamino ran away from a battle in fear."

speaker: Shamino
text: "Thou must be mad!" Shamino turns to you. "This rogue needs to be taught a lesson."

speaker: Frank
text: "And thy friend, Shamino, <PLAYER_NAME>, has quite a bellicose temper."

speaker: Frank
text: "And," he pauses, peering very closely at your face, "I never noticed how large thy nose is. 'Tis amazing thou canst find enough air to breathe."

speaker: Frank
text: "Yes, bellicose, warlike, angry. If thou dost not know that, I believe thou needest to improve thy vocabulary. Thou art too unschooled."

speaker: Frank
text: "Trust me, <HONORIFIC>, thou art too ignorant to argue with me."

speaker: Dupre
text: "Oh, this is too much!"

speaker: Frank
text: "Truly quite large, and not in the least bit attractive."

speaker: Frank
text: "Thou hast the manners of a pig. 'Tis not polite to break conversation so abruptly."

speaker: Thurston
text: You see a man covered in the sweat of a hard day's work.

speaker: Thurston
text: "Greetings, <HONORIFIC>," says Thurston.

speaker: Thurston
text: "I am Thurston."

speaker: Thurston
text: "I operate the mill here in Paws."

speaker: Thurston
text: "The local economy depends upon the mill for flour. So I ensure that the mill runs. Sometimes, I feel that keeping the wheels turning is the only reason to live."

speaker: Thurston
text: "A sack will cost thee 12 gold. Art thou interested in purchasing some?"

speaker: Thurston
text: "Here it is," he says, handing you the sack. "Wouldst thou wish another?"

speaker: Thurston
text: "Thou hast not the room for this sack."

speaker: Thurston
text: "Thou hast not the gold for this, <HONORIFIC>. Perhaps some other time."

speaker: Thurston
text: "Perhaps next time, <HONORIFIC>."

speaker: Thurston
text: "The mill is closed at present. If thou wouldst please return when it is open again I would gladly sell thee all the flour thou canst carry."

speaker: Thurston
text: "In case thou hadst not noticed, the people who live here are not so well off as their cousins who live in Britain. In fact, we have even had a theft recently."

speaker: Thurston
text: "Indeed, thou shouldst be wary, <HONORIFIC>. There is a thief in this town! Morfin, a merchant, had several vials of valuable silver snake venom stolen."

speaker: Thurston
text: "It is procured from the Silver Serpent. I believe Gargoyles used it habitually in the old days. I am not so sure what it might do to a human. Perhaps Morfin can tell thee more."

speaker: Thurston
text: "I have paid thee once for thy delivery. I shall not do so again."

speaker: Thurston
text: You give the sack over to Thurston. He opens it and reaches inside. His hand comes back out filled with wheat. He sifts through it with his fingers. "I know Camille is oft quite busy running her farm. Thanks to thee for making the delivery."

speaker: Thurston
text: "This should compensate thee for thy trouble." He hands you ten gold pieces.

speaker: Thurston
text: "'Tis a puzzlement! Camille promised to make a delivery of wheat to me sometime today and it is late. I wonder where it could be."

speaker: Thurston
text: "I have no wife or family. I have thought about joining The Fellowship, but I refuse. I have nothing but my work, and a drink at the Salty Dog now and then."

speaker: Thurston
text: "I know they do good work here in town, but there is just something about them that makes me uncomfortable."

speaker: Thurston
text: He notices your Fellowship medallion and hurriedly clears his throat. "No offense intended, <HONORIFIC>."

speaker: Thurston
text: "In truth, I go there more to be near Polly, the innkeeper, than for the wine. But she is always busy tending bar and has no time for me, I am sure."

speaker: Thurston
text: "I should go to the Salty Dog and see Polly." Thurston stares off into space for a few moments, his eyes are big and he has a moony expression on his face. Suddenly, he snaps back to reality. "Excuse me, thou wert saying something?"

speaker: Thurston
text: You relate to Thurston what Polly had said about him. He looks at you with joyous surprise. "Did Polly really say these things?! It is ridiculous that she believes I am too good for her!" Suddenly he forgets his work and starts hurrying around in excitement. "For years I have loved this woman from afar. I will begin courting her immediately!"

speaker: Thurston
text: "I want to thank thee for telling me the truth about Polly's feelings about me. I can be such a stick in the mud running this bloody mill all of the time that I would never have noticed it if she were wearing a sign on her back! This is just what I needed to help me start enjoying my life!"

speaker: Thurston
text: "Good day to thee, <HONORIFIC>."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "Avatar! Didst thou know that the merchant Morfin had a quantity of silver serpent venom stolen? This theft has caused the community no small amount of distress."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "Avatar! Oh Avatar! I have news!"

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "Garritt, my son, told me that Tobias was in possession of some silver snake venom. I went to investigate and found Tobias with it!"

speaker: Merrick
text: "That is correct! I am a witness that what Feridwyn has said is the truth!"

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "I have often said that Tobias was no good. Now here is proof. He is the thief that has been praying upon one of our honest merchants! And to think I let him come into contact with my son! I hope he shall be dealt with in a manner appropriate to one who is leading youth astray from the way of The Fellowship."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "I suggest that thou go and speak with his mother at once! Camille should keep a tighter rein on her offspring!"

speaker: Feridwyn
text: You see a small man with twisted, sloped posture. He looks you up and down before deciding he will speak to you.

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "I had gotten word that thou wert coming to our town. I have been expecting thee. I must admit, though, that I find it difficult to believe that thou art truly the Avatar."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "Thou dost wish to speak with me again, Avatar?" says Feridwyn.

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "My name is Feridwyn."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "I run the Fellowship shelter with my wife Brita and my son Garritt here in Paws."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "Wouldst thou like to join?"

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "Then thou must see Batlin of Britain. He is the founder of The Fellowship."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "Thou dost not yet comprehend how much thy life could be improved through the guidance of The Fellowship."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "Gentle Avatar, it is good of thee to come to our humble town. Thou canst well see that The Fellowship has much work to do if it is to alleviate the suffering of the unfortunate of Britannia."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "This is the only place in all of Britannia designed for the aid and care of the poor. It is hard work, but then one strives to be worthy of that which we wish to receive."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "A wonderful woman. Thou shouldst meet her."

speaker: Brita
text: "Mine husband is such a flatterer. The truth is that our work for The Fellowship has brought us closer together."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "As thou dost already know my wife Brita, I am certain thou wilt agree that thou couldst not find a more dedicated practitioner of The Fellowship's teachings."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "Thankfully, we have been able to raise our son properly by emphasizing the teachings of The Fellowship. Garritt shall not be trapped in the poverty of his surroundings. He shall be intellectually, spiritually, and morally superior. He's talented, too!"

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "He plays the whistle panpipes extremely well for a lad his age! Brita and I are very proud. He could probably attend The Music Hall in Britain when he is older!"

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "As this is a small town with few privileges and little privacy, our family has come to know everyone in Paws quite well. Is there someone thou dost wish to hear about? I am well acquainted with these people."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "They would be Morfin, Andrew, Thurston, and Beverlea."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "She is a nearly blind elderly woman who runs the antique shoppe on the east side of the river."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "That would be Camille and her son Tobias."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "Oh. Them. Komor and Fenn." Feridwyn rolls his eyes.

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "Our residents include Alina and her child, and Merrick."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "Her husband is currently in Britain somewhere. I do not know the details. She has a small child."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "I am so sorry! Thou hast just missed them! Elizabeth and Abraham were here delivering funds, but they have gone now to Jhelom. There is currently no Fellowship branch there, so they are taking the Triad of Inner Strength to lands west!"

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "I have not seen Elizabeth and Abraham for many days now."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "Thurston owns the mill. He could do better if he ran his business with more of an eye toward profit."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "She's a sad woman -- a widow -- who is living in the past. 'Tis a pity, really. Fortunately her husband left her the farm which does happen to turn a profit."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "A splendid example of The Fellowship turning someone's life around. Presently he resides in our shelter."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "Morfin is a clever and industrious member of The Fellowship. He runs the local slaughterhouse and is also a snake venom merchant."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "Andrew is such a happy young man. He doth not notice the myriad of personal problems that he is afflicted with."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "A local rascal. I normally would not allow Garritt to associate with such a troublemaker, but The Fellowship has taught me to be a tolerant parent. Besides, associating with my son might do the lad some good. Who knows?"

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "No matter that Tobias did not personally steal the venom himself. He caused the theft by means of his corrupting influence on my son. While his actions are just short of criminal, I still blame Tobias."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "Fenn is a beggar who refuses all aid from The Fellowship. A pathetic case. Not even his former friend Merrick can reach him any more."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "Komor is the most hateful man I have ever met. He is a bundle of bitterness. In all the time I have known him, Komor has never spoken a word to me that was not at best a thinly veiled insult."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "Thankfully we can now put this business of snake venom thefts behind us, thanks to thy thorough efforts. I shall deal with my son. Let us speak of this no more."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "Thank goodness Garritt, my sharp eyed boy, got to the bottom of this business of the snake venom thefts. Frankly, I had my suspicions about Tobias myself."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "Morfin, the local merchant, informs me that a quantity of silver serpent venom was stolen from him. The thief is still at large, so be wary! Of course, I do not know why anyone would want the vile substance. It is surely not good for one's health."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "I promise thee, I shall apply the necessary discipline to my son to insure that this bad habit he has picked up from the local riffraff will not trouble this community again."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "Thou didst find the venom vial in Garritt's belongings? I am amazed! I am astonished! I am-- sorry."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "Thou art a resourceful person. Unfortunately, thy discovery has upset me a great deal."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "Thou dost say my son has admitted to stealing the venom?! I do not know what to say. My thanks, Avatar, for uncovering the truth."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "Mayest thou walk with the Fellowship."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: You realize that the Cube did not bring out anything that Feridwyn did not actually believe himself. He is one of the innocent followers of The Guardian.

speaker: Brita
text: A stern-looking woman stares back at you without humor.

speaker: Brita
text: "Greetings to thee, <HONORIFIC>," you hear Brita say.

speaker: Brita
text: "I am Brita."

speaker: Brita
text: "I help mine husband Feridwyn run The Fellowship's shelter in Paws."

speaker: Brita
text: "Mine husband is a good man who devotes himself selflessly to helping the poor of this town, something they do not appreciate. He is a good man and a dutiful Fellowship member."

speaker: Brita
text: "Mine husband is the most honorable man I have ever met in my life."

speaker: Feridwyn
text: "Do not put stock in the proud boasts of wives, good Avatar. I am a simple man who only does what he can."

speaker: Brita
text: "Thou shouldst speak to mine husband of The Fellowship. I am certain thou wilt be most impressed by what he shall have to tell thee."

speaker: Brita
text: "Seeing that thou hast joined The Fellowship only confirms what I already know. That The Fellowship is the path by which we shall lead Britannia to a wonderful new future. News that thou hast joined us is spreading far and wide!"

speaker: Brita
text: "Running the shelter is hard work for mine husband and me, but it is worth the effort to ease the suffering of those less fortunate than we."

speaker: Brita
text: "We hear about everything that goes on in Paws. If I do not know about it then mine husband does. Is there anyone in particular thou dost wish to know about?"

speaker: Brita
text: "I know about these people:"

speaker: Brita
text: "It is good to determine an impression of others on one's own."

speaker: Brita
text: "Alina lives in the shelter with her baby, poor thing. Her husband is a common thief who even now sits in prison. But we shall help her get her life straightened out once we persuade her to join The Fellowship. She is not smart enough, thou knowest, to see the advantages for herself. She must be carefully instructed."

speaker: Brita
text: "Camille is a farm widow. She tends to live in the past, following the old virtues and questioning the ways of The Fellowship. These country folk are so superstitious, thou knowest. It is a fault of their low intellect. She does not even notice what a hooligan her boy, Tobias, is growing up to be! Not at all like our son, Garritt."

speaker: Brita
text: "A simply wretched little urchin. Always sulking. But then, one must realize that he has no father to discipline him properly."

speaker: Brita
text: "Thou dost say that vial of venom was found in Garritt's belongings? I do not believe it! Art thou saying my son is a liar and a thief? I wilt not believe it! Good day to thee!"

speaker: Brita
text: "So Garritt admits he stole the venom vial. I cannot believe it! I do not know what to say."

speaker: Brita
text: Brita beams. "Garritt is a wonderful son. He is being raised to follow the values of The Fellowship. His worthiness has been rewarded."

speaker: Brita
text: Brita frowns even more than before. "If thou dost ask me, 'twas all a plot to get my little boy in trouble. If thou had not come to town, this entire incident would not have happened!"

speaker: Brita
text: "Garritt is so talented at the whistle panpipes! It is truly a gift!"

speaker: Brita
text: "Polly runs the local tavern to be near people. She is a lonely soul and feels that there is simply no one who wishes for her heart. It makes me so sad to think of her. She could find all the companionship she could want if she would join The Fellowship."

speaker: Brita
text: "One of our members, a local merchant named Morfin, had a shipment of silver serpent venom stolen from him. Not that I care about the venom itself, but is it not shocking?"

speaker: Brita
text: "I have never seen any myself. I have no idea what it does to someone, but it cannot possibly be good!"

speaker: Brita
text: "Mayest thou walk with The Fellowship, Avatar."

speaker: Alina
text: You see a simple peasant woman. Her face is etched with sorrow.

speaker: Alina
text: "Good day, <HONORIFIC>," says Alina.

speaker: Alina
text: "I am Alina."

speaker: Alina
text: "I have none, <HONORIFIC>, save for being the mother of my child. I am waiting for mine husband, Weston, to return from Britain."

speaker: Alina
text: "Cassie is my daughter. Just a wee babe, she is mine only joy."

speaker: Alina
text: "Good news, <HONORIFIC>! Mine husband was pardoned by Lord British. He even provided Weston with short-term employment so that he may return to me with money enough in his pockets to feed us for some time!"

speaker: Alina
text: "Excellent news, no?"

speaker: Alina
text: "Mine husband is imprisoned in Britain for stealing fruit from the Royal Orchards."

speaker: Alina
text: "Mine husband is no thief, <HONORIFIC>. He went there to buy fruit for the child and me so that we would have enough to eat. He has been wrongfully accused, I am certain of it!"

speaker: Alina
text: "We are very poor. My baby and I are presently living in the Fellowship shelter because we have nowhere else to go."

speaker: Alina
text: "It was a member of The Fellowship that has accused mine husband. Now they wish for me to join them."

speaker: Alina
text: "Mine husband is innocent, I know it!. He intended to buy the fruit. Why must I join thy society in order for me to be taken at my word?"

speaker: Alina
text: "We are fortunate that we are able to live by The Fellowship's good graces, but I do not know how long we will be allowed to stay."

speaker: Alina
text: "I cannot join The Fellowship without feeling that I am betraying mine husband. How could I become one of those who have falsely accused him? Yet, if I do not, they will not allow my child and me to live here."

speaker: Alina
text: She sobs and covers her face with her hands. "It is so unfair. I must choose between starvation and betrayal. If only Weston were here. I do not know what to do!"

speaker: Alina
text: "They say if I join they will attempt to free mine husband. But it was they who unjustly accused him. I cannot trust them, but I fear I may have no choice."

speaker: Alina
text: "They tell me the shelter is only for members of The Fellowship. Unless I join soon, I shall be asked to leave. And I have nowhere else to go."

speaker: Alina
text: "Pleasant day to thee, <HONORIFIC>."

speaker: Merrick
text: You see a nervous man who constantly blinks. He sees you and looks like he is in a snit. "Who art thou?"

speaker: Merrick
text: "Very well, <PLAYER_NAME>. What dost thou want?"

speaker: Merrick
text: "Fine!"

speaker: Merrick
text: "Thou art a most pathetic little worm. Really, all this Avatar nonsense is nothing more than a sad plea for attention."

speaker: Merrick
text: "Oh, <PLAYER_NAME>. It is thee!"

speaker: Merrick
text: "I am Merrick."

speaker: Merrick
text: "I used to be a farmer here in Paws. Now I suppose I work for the Fellowship. I live in their shelter."

speaker: Merrick
text: "I do most humbly apologize to thee, <PLAYER_NAME>. As I am certain thou art aware, there have been many who have claimed to be the one and only true Avatar ever since thou hast last visited us."

speaker: Merrick
text: "I was a farmer; of course, that was before the seven year drought. Komor, Fenn and myself were reduced to paupers."

speaker: Merrick
text: "I heard that Garritt was the one who stole the venom. Hmm! And to think I live under the same roof with the hoodlum. I shall have to guard my belongings more."

speaker: Merrick
